name: print-social-lavender-grid-paper-ticket-is-worth-money-today-fading-headline-post
title: Your Ticket Is Worth Money Today Fading Headline
whatItIs: A lavender graph-paper post with a small logo and a mono NIGERIA · RESALE label, a large headline that fades line by line: 'Your ticket is worth money TODAY.' in dark with blue emphasis, 'Tomorrow it's worth less.' in grey and 'After the event worth nothing.' almost invisible, three pill chips with the same timeline (the last struck through), a cut-out collage of a stressed man with a phone, clock, clipboard and hands, and a blue footer bar with the site and a LIST TODAY button.
whatItMeans: The headline literally loses value as it fades, making the message physical, and the collage adds humour to the stress.
techniques: Headline fading line by line to illustrate loss
Pill chips repeating the timeline, last one struck through
Cut-out collage of hands, phone, clock and clipboard
Solid blue footer bar with CTA

vocabulary.definition: Lines that lose opacity to express decline.
Masked photo pieces arranged around a subject.
A coloured strip at the bottom with a link and a button.
